answer_2.quote: Coverage@K is used to evaluate whether Top-K retrieved candidates include the ground-truth response...Perplexity@K is the average perplexity of Top-K retrieved responses...Relevance@K is the average predicted correlation degree between query and Top-K retrieved responses.

answer_3.quote: DialogGPT is used to calculate the conditional perplexity of the retrieved response given the query...DialogRPT...which is pre-trained on large-scale human feedback data...predicts how likely the response is corresponding to the given context.

answer_4.quote: To further evaluate and compare our models, we conduct a human evaluation experiment. We random select 1000 queries...Three crowd-sourcing workers are asked to score the responses.
answer_4.guideline: annotators ranked the retrieved responses of the three models for each query
